baseline.warning: P3.6 audit baseline only. Field Journey outcomes, official precise boundaries and professional feasibility remain UNKNOWN until rechecked.

locked_thesis.zh: 把人的完整 Journey 设为跨项目城市建设的共同交付单元——站点、道路、公园和地块只有在任一目标人群、关键时段与故障情景下都存在端到端可用路径或合规等价替代时，才算共同完成。
locked_thesis.en: Treat the complete human journey as the shared delivery unit of cross-project city building: a station, road, park and parcel are jointly complete only when every target group has an end-to-end usable route, or a compliant equivalent alternative, in critical time periods and failure scenarios.
locked_thesis.plain_zh: 城市以项目为单位建设，人却以完整 Journey 为单位生活。项目完成，不等于旅程完成。
locked_thesis.core_protocol: Evidence -> Journey -> Interface failure -> Spatial intervention -> Re-audit
locked_thesis.method_boundary: The Auditor only checks evidence and ordered interfaces. It does not replace spatial design, professional judgment, approval, governance or human accountability.

future_design_action_contract.rule: Every core spatial action populates all eight fields in phase3_4/data/action_geometry_mapping.json and corresponding GeoJSON features. Unknown owners remain roles, not invented commitments.

controlled_vocabularies.p3_2_outcome_constraint: Every current Journey/profile outcome is UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN is neither zero nor FAIL and cannot be compensated by other profiles.
controlled_vocabularies.source_promotion_rule: REPRODUCIBLE_PUBLIC, INFERENCE, DESIGN_HYPOTHESIS, SCENARIO_SIMULATION and UNKNOWN must never be promoted to official evidence.

evidence_count_summary.counting_rule: A-E/F count records in facts; UNKNOWN counts records in unknowns. Zero is an inventory count, not an observed city-performance value.

rule_design_implications.design_implication: Treat continuity across road, park, parcel and building boundaries as one accessible route; include maintenance and an actually usable alternative where necessary.
Street/crossing options require functional classification, traffic organization, walking/cycling, accessibility, curb and static-traffic review before a section is fixed.
Prioritize people, public space, retention/improvement, multiple participation and phased implementation; do not bypass statutory planning.
Any station, underground, elevated or exit-interface action is conditional on operator, safety, emergency and passenger-organization review; provide legible normal and failure information.
Obtain the official heritage inventory and control zones before earthworks, structures, attachments, lighting or interpretation near protected resources.
Vertical links, shared floors, enclosed passages and property thresholds must preserve evacuation, fire access, compartmentation and management requirements determined by qualified professionals.
Coordinate routes, planting, levels, inlets, storage and maintenance with survey/hydrology; rain gardens cannot block accessible movement or be claimed effective without calculation.

Keep the research Auditor on non-personal/aggregated records by default; do not collect faces, device IDs or trajectories merely to prove a route; perform a separate impact/security review before deployment.
AI output is advisory and traceable; human/professional review decides interventions; public service deployment requires separate scope, data, filing/safety and complaint-process review.

input_required_per_interface: project status with source and date
segment_evaluation: If required evidence is missing, segment outcome is UNKNOWN.
Only verified evidence can support PASS or FAIL.
Project status never substitutes for segment outcome.
An official plan or approved scope is not as-built performance.
journey_evaluation: A profile Journey can PASS only if every ordered segment and required condition passes or has a compliant equivalent fallback.
Any verified FAIL makes that profile Journey FAIL.
Any UNKNOWN prevents that profile Journey from passing.
Overall Journey PASS is prevented by one FAIL or one UNKNOWN among target profiles.

current_result.interpretation: Counts of register states only. The zero PASS/FAIL counts do not mean observed performance is zero; performance is UNKNOWN.
